spacing.$description: Confirmed from the Figma Spacing page. Every value here already exists at the same pixel value in Tailwind's default spacing scale (see the generated Tailwind preset) — so adopting this scale requires zero Tailwind config changes, only the discipline to stop using arbitrary bracket values (px-[0.938rem] etc.) found throughout all 5 apps.

0_5.$description: NEW (2026-10-21), synced from the Figma v2 file's Spacing/0_5 variable — a hairline step for 2px gaps and padding. Keyed 0_5, not 0.5, because Style Dictionary reads a dot in a key as a path separator; the Tailwind preset and DESIGN.md convert it back to 0.5, which matches Tailwind's own default step.
